title: 617 Squadron Aircrew - Derwent Valley
memorial_details: A rectangular brass plaque with polished narrow raised border and inscription in upright capital Roman lettering against a stippled ground. The stone of remembrance (our reference 14270) is about 18 inches below.
inscription: THIS PLAQUE UNVEILED ON 16TH MAY 1988/ COMMEMORATES THE NIGHT OF/ 16TH 17TH MAY 1943/ WHEN 19 LANCASTERS OF 617 SQD R.A.F./ ATTACKED THE RUHR DAMS AT LOW LEVEL/ ALSO REMEMBERED HERE ARE THE/ 204 617 SQD. AIRCREW WHO LAID DOWN/ THEIR LIVES BETWEEN 1943 - 1945
custodian: The building forms part of the structure of Derwent Dam, owned by Severn Trent Water Ltd.
crash_date_review: Auto-corrected to 16th May 1943 but reverted — text date, not ISO
